newsitem.title: USA: Wis. Senate passes amended Milwaukee stadium bill.
newsitem.headline: Wis. Senate passes amended Milwaukee stadium bill.

text.p: The Wisconsin Senate on Tuesday approved a compromise bill that limits the powers of the board overseeing financing and construction of a new ballpark for the Milwaukee Brewers American League baseball team, a committee clerk said.
The compromise reached last week in a senate committee would impose limits on the Southeast Wisconsin Professional Baseball Park District that one board member said at the time would be livable.

The bill as passed by senators would delete the state's moral obligation on insured tax-exempt sales revenue bonds sold for stadium construction, require quarterly board reports to legislative leaders and guarantee a sunset date at some point in the future for the five-county sales tax instituted to back bonds for the stadium.
The compromise bill between Sen. Lynn Adelman, D-New Berlin, and Sen. Joe Wineke, D-Verona, next goes to representatives for consideration.
